seoDescription: Tick-to-trade in FPGA fabric: market-data feed parsing on the wire, an in-fabric order book and a decision path measured in nanoseconds.

sections.heading: TICK → TRADE
sections.body: When an exchange sends a price update, whoever answers first gets the trade. This pipeline makes the whole decision in an FPGA: an ITCH market message comes in one side and a finished OUCH order leaves the other, a fixed handful of clock cycles later. PS is control-plane only.

images.alt: Monopoly's Rich Uncle Pennybags holding an EAT THE RICH sign
images.caption: // the market maker earns the spread. The fastest one eats first.

sections.heading: THE PIPELINE
sections.body: every block bit-exact vs a Python golden model, then mutation-tested so a broken design is proven to fail · GHDL 4.1.0 + Vivado xsim 2025.1

sections.heading: WHERE THE CYCLES GO
sections.body: The parallel parser takes 8 bytes a cycle, the width of a 10G AXIS bus, and decodes every field of every message type in one cycle by speculating. Smaller, faster, and 12× lower latency. It assumes a 64-bit ingress from a 10G or 25G MAC.

items.value: Timed replay with LOBSTER-derived gaps: wire-to-trade median 13 / p99 96 cyc, ≈43 / 320 ns at 300 MHz. latency_ts is last-tick-wins, a lower-bound proxy under bursts.

items.label: TOP_IMPL_2P0
items.detail: Routed. WNS −0.245 ns, TNS −0.525 ns. The aggressive stretch target.

items.label: TOP_IMPL_3P0
items.detail: Routed. WNS +0.315 ns, TNS 0. 751 LUT, 688 FF, 0 BRAM, 0 DSP.

items.label: HFT_TICK_TO_TRADE_TOP
items.detail: WNS +1.828 ns. Its report is marked Synthesized, not Routed. 688 FF, no BRAM or DSP.

items.label: MOLDUDP64 INGRESS
items.detail: 400 real AAPL packets, 0 gaps, 199 OUCH out, BBO bit-exact vs golden. GHDL and xsim.

items.label: SOUPBINTCP OVER TOE
items.detail: SYN / SYN-ACK / ACK, then the order leaves as a TCP data segment, seq 1001, PSH|ACK. Payload bit-exact.

items.label: CLOSED LOOP
items.detail: The exchange sends a fill back over the same session; fill_rx decodes it. net_position = +100.

sections.heading: THE PAYOFF
sections.body: Order out, fill in, inventory updated, all over one established TCP session. The loop closes in simulation: market data, decision, SoupBinTCP egress through the TOE, execution report back through fill_rx.

items.value: Simulated, not traded. No exchange, no colocation, no money moved.

images.alt: Cartoon man in sunglasses hugging stacks of cash
images.caption: // net_position = +100

sections.heading: 05 RISK & HONEST SCOPE
sections.body: risk_gate is a hardware interlock. An order that breaks position or size limits is blocked in the circuit, not logged by software downstream.

items.value: No exchange feed or colocation. Latency is sim datapath cycles, not live wire-to-trade.
No hardware run recorded on the ZCU106; silicon is the target.
bbo_book is single-level: no depth, no order-id matching.
strategy_mm emits one buy quote when spread ≥ threshold; sell side and inventory band are future work.
